title: Chennai’s second airport: grounded until take-off
description: With the Parandur airport now a closed chapter, Tamil Nadu has to press ahead with another alternative, viable site for Chennai’s second airport. This report takes a look at the options ahead of the State and the processes involved in establishing a new airport. Cheyyur in Chengalpattu district and Gummidipoondi in Tiruvallur district are the top contenders for Chennai’s second airport
